instruction: Please configure Chrome to block third-party cookies to prevent cross-site tracking.

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking third-party cookies in Chrome privacy settings. Custom getter get_chrome_block_third_party_cookies__327d732b checks Chrome Preferences for block_third_party_cookies flag and cookie_controls_mode setting. Returns 'true' when third-party cookies are blocked.
metadata.verification: Custom getter verifies block_third_party_cookies flag or cookie_controls_mode >= 1 in Chrome Preferences profile section.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL SEMANTIC ERROR: Getter logic at chrome.py:45 uses 'cookie_controls_mode >= 1' which incorrectly accepts Incognito-only blocking (mode=1). Instruction requires blocking third-party cookies 'to prevent cross-site tracking' which implies ALL browsing contexts, not just Incognito.

False positive scenario: If user only sets 'Block third-party cookies in Incognito' (cookie_controls_mode=1), evaluator incorrectly returns 'true' and marks task as complete, even though normal browsing still allows third-party cookies.
Correct logic should check 'cookie_controls_mode == 2' (block all third-party) or 'cookie_controls_mode >= 2' if future modes exist, not '>= 1'.
All other aspects are correct: postconfig properly restarts Chrome, file path logic covers all OS types, exact_match metric is appropriate, and data types match correctly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change chrome.py:45 from 'return "true" if (block_third_party or cookie_controls_mode >= 1) else "false"' to 'return "true" if (block_third_party or cookie_controls_mode == 2) else "false"'
Alternatively, if Chrome's cookie_controls_mode semantics allow values >2 for stronger blocking, use 'cookie_controls_mode >= 2' to future-proof the logic
Add a comment explaining: cookie_controls_mode values: 0=allow all, 1=block in Incognito only, 2=block all third-party cookies
